resolution: Built reportAssetGeometry() in editors/model/geometryReport.ts — the / dashboard's geometry census. It walks both authored content stores (cooked assets and Studio models) and sums triangles/vertices/edges, returning cooked/studio/total totals plus roster counts and a distinct-mesh count. Cooked MeshBlob is a triangle soup (8 floats/vert, count already stored); Studio EditMesh is verts[] + n-gon faces (fanned to tris, unique edges via the existing meshEdges). Pure in-memory read — no tessellation/GPU/blob-decode — so it honors the freeze law and can run off first paint; headless-safe. Resolved OPEN-1c: no cook-time count field needed. Pure helpers unit-tested 3/3 (cuboid 8/12/12, soup math, empty). Committed as 4378067b3.
